entities.summary: Mohamed Aziz Dougaz is a Tunisian tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of No. 192, achieved on 21 October 2024. He also has a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 261, achieved on 2 December 2019. He is currently the No. 2 Tunisian player.
